name: b5-obs-states
title: B5-OBS 1/6: hover, pressed, focus and disabled states of the toolbar, tabs, segments, fields, bottom bars, sheet buttons and Settings controls; tooltip; menu entrance.

steps.note: Shapes.swift and Counter.swift in two tabs, Shapes selected. AX tree (frames of every control).
Run (toolbar): pointer onto it, rests 1.2 s, then leaves to window point (700, 500) for 1.0 s. Hover still = the video frame 1.0 s after the hover.
Run (toolbar): mouse held 0.5 s, then dragged off and released at (700, 500) (nothing triggers). Held still = the frame 0.4 s after mouse-down.
